name: Dropdown Terminal
author: Hung Vo
description: A focused Omarchy dropdown terminal with bounded entrance effects, interactive pets, and privacy-preserving command completion indicators.

barWidget.description: Summon the configured default terminal with optional effects, pets, and shell-aware completion indicators.

schema.label: Show icon
schema.description: Show the dropdown terminal icon in the bar.

schema.label: Bar icon
schema.description: Nerd Font glyph or text shown for the terminal button.

schema.label: Global keybinding
schema.description: Hyprland key chord for toggling the terminal, for example CTRL + GRAVE or SUPER + SHIFT + T.

schema.label: Auto-hide on focus loss
schema.description: Hide the terminal by toggling its animated special workspace when another window receives focus.

schema.label: Allow focus through dropdown
schema.description: Let normal windows receive pointer focus while the floating dropdown is open. Adds a managed input.special_fallthrough override to your Hyprland config.

schema.label: Slide down from top
schema.description: Drop the terminal in from the top edge instead of Hyprland's upward special-workspace slide. Briefly speeds up the global specialWorkspace animation node at runtime and restores it afterwards; the In/Out child nodes are never modified.

schema.label: Auto-hide delay (milliseconds)
schema.description: Wait briefly after focus changes before hiding the terminal.

schema.label: Terminal width (%)
schema.description: Width of the dropdown terminal as a percentage of the focused monitor.

schema.label: Terminal height (%)
schema.description: Height of the dropdown terminal as a percentage of the focused monitor.

schema.label: Border color
schema.description: Use theme to follow Omarchy, or a Hyprland color such as rgb(ff8800).

schema.label: Entrance effect
schema.description: Show a brief decorative finish after the terminal reaches its final position. Fire / burn, firework, thunder, snow, and rain are available.

schema.label: Effect intensity (%)
schema.description: Set the opacity and bounded particle density of the selected entrance effect.

schema.label: Pet
schema.description: Show a decorative pet on the terminal edge. Tap or hold it to pet it; it never changes the meaning of the command indicator.

schema.label: Villains
schema.description: After a precise tracked command failure, let a bug or ghost visit the pet.

schema.label: Pet species
schema.description: Choose the bundled penguin, fluffy cat, or corgi pack. Each uses the same validated action contract.

schema.label: Pet activity
schema.description: Choose when the selected pet may walk, sleep, or react while the terminal is visible. Playful uses more frequent, longer routes.

schema.label: Respond to clicks
schema.description: Allow a bounded input region over the visible pet. Clicks elsewhere, including the terminal resize grab ring, still reach the terminal.

schema.label: Pet roaming
schema.description: Choose whether the pet walks along the top edge or uses the whole border when its pack has wall-safe climb frames.

schema.label: Drag to move
schema.description: Pick up the pet and drop it at the nearest allowed edge position.

schema.label: Pointer awareness
schema.description: Add a 24 or 48 pixel awareness halo. Clicks inside the halo reach the pet layer, not the desktop or a window behind it.

schema.label: Voice
schema.description: Show an authored speech bubble for qualifying command results and petting.

schema.label: Sound
schema.description: Play short pet cues through pw-play or paplay. Sound is independent of reduced motion.

schema.label: Remember position
schema.description: Restore the pet's edge and position after a shell reload during this login session.

schema.label: Reduce motion
schema.description: Disable infinite pet, entrance, and status-icon animation; the terminal remains fully usable.

schema.label: Urgency indicator
schema.description: Show a generic attention badge when the managed terminal raises compositor urgency.

schema.label: Command tracking
schema.description: Read precise shell completion events after explicit shell integration is installed.

schema.label: Command notify threshold (milliseconds)
schema.description: Only commands at least this long produce a completion indicator.

schema.label: Failure indicator
schema.description: Show nonzero command exits as failed.

schema.label: Treat Ctrl-C as failure
schema.description: Treat exit status 130 as a failed command instead of ignoring cancellation.
